title: Visit Allowance and Extra-Visit Fee Schedule — Summit Club Memberships
content:
Whether a Crestline Summit Club Lounge Memberships holder's visits are capped in each membership year, how many visit days the cap includes, and the fee for each visit day beyond it.

| Membership | Visits capped per membership year | Visit days included per membership year | Fee per visit day beyond the included visit days (USD) | Several entries on one calendar day count as one visit day | Visit count starts again at each renewal date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Summit Club Essential | Yes | 10 | 50 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Club Individual | No | 0 (no cap applies) | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Club Individual Plus | No | 0 (no cap applies) | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Club Executive | No | 0 (no cap applies) | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Club Corporate | No | 0 (no cap applies) | 0 | Yes | Yes |
| Summit Club Lifetime | No | 0 (no cap applies) | 0 | Yes | Yes |

## Notes distinguishing the memberships

- Summit Club Essential is the only membership in the range whose visits are capped. Its membership year includes 10 visit days, and each visit day beyond those 10 carries a fee of 50 USD.
- For the other five memberships no cap applies: the visit-days figure is 0 because there is no cap, and there is no extra-visit fee (0 USD).
- On every membership, several entries on one calendar day count as one visit day, and the visit count starts again at each renewal date.

## Reading the Summit Club Essential row (illustration)

| Visit days already used in the membership year | Next visit day | Within the 10 included? | Extra-visit fee for that day |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | the 10th | Yes | none |
| 10 | the 11th | No | 50 USD |
| 11 | the 12th | No | 50 USD |
